correctness.rationale: For all-positive selected chords, crossing components force the canonical finest noncrossing partition. Negative chords have unmerged singleton endpoints. If t negatives remain, b=2t+r>=2t cyclic block transitions but no more than t can be forbidden negative matching sides, giving a safe adjacent-block merger to toggle parity. If t=0 and r>=2 a safe merge also exists; only connected all-positive crossing graph forces the unique odd one-block realization. The universal n−2 VC upper bound is forest-plus-spanning-tree parity, lower bound a boundary path leaving one unconstrained vertex whose adjacent merger toggles parity. Narayana reflection gives equinumerosity at even n. Executed direct exhaustive checker verifies m=2,3,4 and n=6 3-query totals; finite checks are not infinite proofs.
